tdsProducts.summary: Slow-setting higher-viscosity instant adhesive for rough or uneven parts where you want a little alignment time before lockup.

tdsProducts.cureDetail: One-part ethyl cyanoacrylate; moisture-triggered room-temperature cure
cautions: Pot life is not applicable/not published for this one-component instant adhesive.
Thermal conductivity and lap-shear strength are not published in the cached official 3M TDS.
For optimum strength structural bonds, remove paint, oxide films, oils, dust, mold release agents and other contaminants.
When using solvents, extinguish ignition sources and follow solvent manufacturer precautions.
Store refrigerated at 0-4 C / 32-40 F; do not freeze; keep containers tightly covered and free of moisture; avoid direct sun.
Industrial/occupational product; not designed or tested for certain automotive applications including electric powertrain battery or high-voltage applications.
tdsProducts.fixtureTimeNote: Published as Time to Handling Strength 12-60 s.

tdsProducts.summary: Web-spray synthetic-rubber contact adhesive for trim, door panels, laminates, upholstery, and other demanding flexible bonds.
tdsProducts.name: WELDWOOD Original Contact Cement Spray Adhesive
tdsProducts.chemistry: Synthetic rubber, solvent-based aerosol contact adhesive
tdsProducts.cureDetail: Spray both surfaces and allow to dry until aggressively tacky; TDS says allow up to 5–10 minutes before bonding. Keep the assembly out of direct sunlight and in stable conditions until fully dried, approximately 24 hours. Product page describes readiness to bond in 1–3 minutes; actual timing depends on conditions.
cautions: The aerosol is extremely flammable while dispensing; eliminate ignition sources and follow the product label and SDS.
TDS recommends test applications, especially on porous substrates where multiple coats may be needed.
TDS does not publish a quantified strength result; no lap-shear value is entered.

tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: DAP WELDWOOD Multi-Purpose Spray Adhesive Technical Data Sheet, revision March 2024.
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: DAP WELDWOOD Multi-Purpose Spray Adhesive Technical Data Sheet, revision 2024-03
tdsProducts.summary: Mist-spray adhesive for removable or permanent bonding of lightweight materials in craft, hobby, and general assembly work.
tdsProducts.name: WELDWOOD Multi-Purpose Spray Adhesive
tdsProducts.cureDetail: For removable bonds, spray one surface and join immediately. For permanent bonds, spray both surfaces and allow about 1 minute to dry until tacky, then press firmly. Keep the assembly in stable conditions until fully dried, approximately 24 hours.
cautions: The aerosol is extremely flammable while dispensing; eliminate ignition sources and follow the product label and SDS.
The TDS describes temporary and permanent bonding of lightweight materials; it does not publish quantitative strength values.
Coverage varies with substrate porosity and is stated at 1 g/ft² on a single surface.

tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: DAP WELDWOOD Nonflammable Contact Cement Technical Data Sheet, revision August 2018.
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: DAP WELDWOOD Nonflammable Contact Cement Technical Data Sheet, revision 2018-08
tdsProducts.summary: Waterborne, high-solids polychloroprene contact adhesive for laminates, veneers, paneling, leather, fabrics, rubber, paper, and similar bonds.
standards: Meets current VOC requirements (per manufacturer TDS)
tdsProducts.name: WELDWOOD Nonflammable Contact Cement
tdsProducts.cureDetail: Apply to both surfaces and allow 60–70 minutes to dry until tacky and glossy. Open/assembly time is 2.5–3 hours and varies with temperature and humidity. Bond with firm, even pressure; maximum holding strength in 7 days. TDS requires air, adhesive, and surfaces above 65°F for at least 24 hours before and after application.
cautions: Not for structural applications, copper or copper alloys, polystyrene foam, or heavy-gauge metal.
At least one bonded surface must be porous; painted or nonporous surfaces should be roughened.
Solvents in the formula may stain or damage painted surfaces, vinyl, or some plastics; test first.
Despite the TDS service rating up to 180°F, it calls for at least 72 hours of cure before direct sunlight or temperatures above 150°F.
Application-temperature discrepancy: the 2018 TDS specifies 65–120°F, while DAP’s current product page lists 40–100°F; check the current label or manufacturer guidance for the applicable batch.

tdsProducts.sourceRevisionDate: DAP WELDWOOD Landau Top & Trim High Heat Resistant Spray Grade Contact Cement Technical Data Sheet, revision August 2018.
tdsProducts.tdsDocumentLabel: DAP WELDWOOD Landau Top & Trim High Heat Spray Grade Contact Cement Technical Data Sheet, revision 2018-08
tdsProducts.summary: Professional spray-grade polychloroprene contact cement for automotive headliners, upholstery, carpeting, laminates, and similar trim work requiring heat resistance.
standards: Federal Specification A-A-1936 performance requirements (per TDS)
tdsProducts.appearance: Natural or red liquid (color varies by grade)
tdsProducts.name: WELDWOOD Landau Top & Trim High Heat Spray-Grade Contact Cement
tdsProducts.cureDetail: For conventional spray, allow both coated surfaces to dry 5–10 minutes; hot spray dry time is about 2–5 minutes. The surfaces bond instantly on contact and cannot be shifted after joining. Open time is up to 2 hours. Cure assemblies for at least 72 hours before exposing them to direct sunlight or temperatures above 150°F. Adhesive, surfaces, and work area must be at least 65°F.
cautions: Manufacturer TDS specifies industrial or professional use only.
Not for structural applications, copper, copper alloys, reactive metals, soft plastics, vinyl, or polystyrene foam; test other plastics first.
Solvent adhesive has a flash point below 20°F; observe the current label and SDS handling precautions.
TDS says bond should cure at least 72 hours before direct sunlight or exposure above 150°F.
